source_instruction: i am looking for 3mp motion detection security camera.
query:
Hey, I swung by that little community garden plot I’ve been tending on my walk over here today, and you won’t believe what I spotted when I knelt down to check on the cherry tomato plants I put in a couple weeks back. A tiny baby cottontail rabbit was curled up right under the sprawling cucumber vines, munching on a stray clover leaf like it didn’t have a care in the world, and it let me sit there watching it for a full five minutes before it hopped slow as anything into the hedge at the edge of the lot. I also noticed the sunflowers I planted right along the fence line finally popped their first little bright yellow buds open, and there were three bumblebees bumbling around between them so heavy with pollen they could barely stay airborne when they moved from one flower to the next. I even ran into Mrs. Henderson from two blocks over while I was there, and she gave me a paper bag full of the juiciest-looking purple plums off the tree in her backyard, said her tree produced way more than her family could possibly eat this year so she’s handing them out to everyone she sees at the garden.
I’m looking for a video surveillance cam for my front porch that has heat signature tracking, y’know? I definitely don’t want to go over that one price point we talked about last time I was picking up security gear. I just need the regular resolution version, nothing fancy or higher end than what most people grab for basic home use. Can you point me to the options that fit what I’m after?
